about: List prices in US dollars per 1,000,000 tokens, copied from each provider's official pricing page on the date in `accessed`. evals/tokens.mjs turns token counts into dollars with this table. A price that could not be confirmed is null, and a run that needs it gets dollars: null instead of a guess.

fields.cacheWrite5m: tokens written to a 5-minute prompt cache (Anthropic)
fields.cacheWrite1h: tokens written to a 1-hour prompt cache (Anthropic)
fields.cacheWrite: tokens written to the prompt cache (OpenAI lists one rate)
fields.cacheRead: tokens read from the prompt cache
fields.output: output tokens; thinking (Anthropic) and reasoning (OpenAI) tokens are billed as output
fields.multipliers: the same rates as multiples of `input`, as the pricing page states them
fields.longContext: a higher rate that applies to a whole request once its input is over `overInputTokens`

claude-opus-5-5.note: The 1M-token context is billed at the standard rate (no long-context premium). Not used here: fast mode ($8 input / $40 output) and inference_geo "us" (1.1x).

claude-haiku-5-5.note: Two price tiers by prompt size. Claude Code reports usage per model, not per request, so the harness prices at the lower tier and marks the dollars approximate when a request may have been over 100K tokens.

claude-haiku-4-5.note: Claude Code can use a small model for background work; it shows up as its own row in modelUsage.

gpt-6.1-sol.note: Reasoning tokens are billed as output (https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/reasoning). Codex reports one running total per turn, not per request, so the long-context tier cannot be applied exactly; dollars use the short-context tier and are marked approximate.
